_generated_fields: version and package_stem are WRITTEN BY `/sb-release`, not by hand. Canonical version lives in the workspace Cargo.toml; this file mirrors it. Run `/sb-release --verify-only` after editing anything here.
_extra_arches: `arch`/`triple` above are the DEFAULT target and the only one `package_stem` mirrors. Every entry in extra_arches is built from the same source with the same glibc_floor; their package stems are DERIVED at build time as <product>-<version>-<arch> and deliberately not stored, so adding an architecture never adds a mirror site for /sb-release to keep in sync.
